stages.headline: arctg a is the number in (−π/2; π/2) whose tangent is a (any a): arctg 1 = π/4, arctg √3 = π/3.
stages.headlineEnglish: arctg a is the number in (−π/2; π/2) whose tangent is a (any a): arctg 1 = π/4, arctg √3 = π/3.

stages.headline: arcctg a is the number in (0; π) whose cotangent is a: arcctg 1 = π/4, arcctg(−1) = 3π/4, arcctg 0 = π/2.
stages.headlineEnglish: arcctg a is the number in (0; π) whose cotangent is a: arcctg 1 = π/4, arcctg(−1) = 3π/4, arcctg 0 = π/2.

stages.headline: Properties: arctg(−a) = −arctg a, arcctg(−a) = π − arcctg a, arctg a + arcctg a = π/2.
